source: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing (official Google Gemini API pricing, paid tier)
retrievalNote: Retrieved immediately before the Phase 1 readiness gate. Phase 0 recorded the same figures on the same date; this record was re-retrieved rather than carried forward, because stale pricing is how a spend ceiling gets silently exceeded.

gemini-3.5-flash-lite.inputNote: published as $0.30 for text / image / video / audio uniformly

imageTokenModel.tilingRule: larger images are tiled into 768x768 tiles at 258 tokens each; crop unit is approximately floor(min(width,height) / 1.5) and the tile count is the product of each dimension divided by the crop unit

appliedToCertifiedClientPayload.derivation: a 896 px wide frame at either 4:3 or 3:4 yields a crop unit of ~448-597 px and 2x2 = 4 tiles; 4 x 258 = 1032 tokens
appliedToCertifiedClientPayload.confidence: estimate. The tile count depends on the exact aspect ratio of each prepared derivative, and no prepared derivatives exist yet (finding F-1). A free countTokens pre-flight must replace this estimate before any paid run.

certifiedRouteParameters.assumedTextInputNote: conservative upper bound covering the certified identify prompt plus the quality-and-route suffix. Measured IDENTIFY_PROMPT is ~1589 characters; the bound is deliberately generous so the projection cannot under-state cost.

limitations: Token counts for image input are ESTIMATED, not measured. A free countTokens pre-flight is required before paid execution.
Output tokens are projected at the certified hard cap of 2048 for worst-case bounding; observed output will typically be far lower.
These figures authorize nothing. Cost projection is one of several independent Phase 1 gates and does not substitute for the review gate or the credential gate.
